items.title: Decision-doc: design the secondary storyFilesHash + whole-tree-drift downgrade semantics
items.context: Via the decision-doc flow: (a) storyFilesHash = sha over the storys own changed files vs merge-base main (reuse changedFilesBetween / scope-contract diff); (b) new validity rule -- bindings stay valid while storyFilesHash unchanged; (c) whole-tree drift downgraded from instant-reject to a re-attestation-REQUIRED warning (NOT silent rebind, NOT story-diff-only); (d) soundness rationale (why story-diff-only misses transitive deps) + which bindings adopt the secondary signal (review-run, escalation verdicts/fallback, verification evidence).

happy.desc: Decision doc defines storyFilesHash as a secondary signal, keeps whole-tree materialHash recorded, and names review-run, escalation/fallback, and verification evidence adoption points.
Process-fact contract represents the new gate-consumed storyFilesHash/freshness semantics rather than relying on prompt prose.

edge.desc: Decision doc explains why story-diff-only is insufficient for transitive dependency or global gate-fact changes.

adversarial.desc: Decision doc explicitly rejects silent rebind and replacing/removing whole-tree materialHash.

items.title: Implement storyFilesHash computation + thread it as a secondary binding signal
items.context: Compute storyFilesHash from the storys changed files vs merge-base main and record it ALONGSIDE materialHash on review runs, escalation verdicts/fallback, and verification evidence. Keep the whole-tree materialHash byte-unchanged and continue recording it (no inference, no removal). Preserve the usage-ledger/host-independence zero-cross-module-import invariants.

happy.desc: review_run_start captures optional storyFilesHash alongside materialHash and signatures verify when the optional field is present.
verificationEvidence records optional storyFilesHash alongside materialHash without dropping existing materialHash.

edge.desc: Legacy records without storyFilesHash still use the existing strict materialHash freshness path.
Missing or uncomputable storyFilesHash never silently passes a stale materialHash record.

adversarial.desc: Tampering a recorded storyFilesHash invalidates the signed/bound record where signatures consume it.

verificationEvidence.note: flow-stability smoke asserts review-run workspaceBinding captures storyFilesHash alongside materialHash and verifyReviewRun accepts the signed binding.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/lattice-evidence-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: checklist evidence normalization stamps storyFilesHash alongside materialHash, and lattice-evidence smoke proves portable evidence manifests preserve storyFilesHash through manifest/inspect so consumers do not fall back to materialHash-only freshness.
checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit keeps legacy records without storyFilesHash on the existing strict materialHash path.
freshness only downgrades materialHash drift when recorded and current storyFilesHash both exist and match; missing/uncomputable storyFilesHash falls back to strict materialHash behavior.
flow-stability smoke tampers workspaceBinding.storyFilesHash and verifyReviewRun rejects the signed/bound record.

items.title: Gate semantics: valid while storyFilesHash unchanged; whole-tree drift -> re-attestation warning + smoke
items.context: Change the freshness/escalation evaluators so a binding is VALID when storyFilesHash matches even if the whole-tree materialHash drifted; surface whole-tree drift as a re-attestation-REQUIRED warning (never silent rebind). Smoke: an unrelated main merge leaving the storys own files unchanged keeps bindings valid (warning only); a change to the storys own files still invalidates and requires re-attestation; existing strict whole-tree behavior remains available.

happy.desc: An unrelated main merge that leaves story-owned files unchanged keeps bindings valid via matching storyFilesHash and emits a whole-tree drift re-attestation warning.
CLI/validation output no longer asks for recover_evidence solely because unrelated files changed when storyFilesHash matches.

edge.desc: A change to a story-owned material file changes storyFilesHash and still invalidates the binding as stale.
Records without storyFilesHash keep existing strict materialHash stale behavior.

adversarial.desc: Whole-tree materialHash drift is never hidden: the result includes an explicit warning rather than silently claiming full freshness.
Review escalation verdict/fallback records with changed story files are rejected even if unrelated warning behavior exists.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.js && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: review-escalation and flow-stability smokes cover unrelated main merge: matching storyFilesHash keeps records valid and emits re-attestation advisories.
verifier/checklist freshness callbacks pass evidence.storyFilesHash, so matching story hashes avoid stale coverage/recover_evidence solely from unrelated materialHash drift.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.js
